text:
incident-bot: Alert: hosted-us-east GPU pool utilization > 98% and request-queue growth detected for /v1/generate. p95 crossed 1.6s, p99 ~ 5.8s, 503s rising. Auto-provisioner reported repeated 'pending' instances.

jess-eng: seeing continuous queue growth from a single customer burst, but other clients also affected. dashboard: https://redwood/d/queues/hosted-us-east

mike-oncall: I'm on it, standing up in #eng-oncall. Any deploys? deploy-bot: No recent model deploys in last 30m.

sam-sre: provisioning API is returning create -> pending -> failed with message: 
```
Error: Insufficient quota for requested GPU SKU: limit=10, requested=12
Retryable: false
```
Looks like we hit a quota cap on the cloud side and autoscaler kept retrying then hitting backoff.

jess-eng: that matches: autoscaler made 6 attempts and then gave up, left many requests queued.

lia-product: any customer-visible errors? we need to notify CS if SLAs impacted.

mike-oncall: p50/p90 okay but p95/p99 rocket. Errors are timeouts at the proxy layer, 502/504. I'm putting a short customer message template together.

ops-rotation: can we throttle non-critical tiers? Suggest enabling degraded-mode routing to smaller quantized model (gpt-small-q4) for best-effort traffic.

sam-sre: Good call. Plan: 1) immediate routing change to favor dedicated pools for premium customers, 2) enable degraded model for free/unknown clients, 3) escalate quota to cloud, 4) cancel stuck provision attempts.

jess-eng: doing 1 & 2 now. Command:
```
# switch route weights: premium -> dedicated, default -> gpt-small-q4
redwood routes update --name /v1/generate --set-weights premium:0.7,default:0.3 --fallback-model gpt-small-q4
```

deploy-bot: Route update applied by jess-eng at 2765432120.

mike-oncall: I'm seeing immediate drop in 500s for premium customers. Default traffic still slow but queue growth rate reduced. p99 down from 5.8s -> 3.2s for premium.

sam-sre: I cleared stuck provision records and killed pending instance requests via cloud console to stop churn. Also bumped autoscaler max_instances from 120 -> 150 as a stop-gap.

jess-eng: Autoscaler bumped, but cloud quota blocks remain for some machines. Sam, did cloud team confirm escalation?

sam-sre: opened ticket with cloud provider (INC-99877). They acknowledge quota limit and are reviewing; ETA unknown. Meanwhile we can use smaller SKUs in other regions.

lia-product: Quick customer impact note for CS: "Intermittent timeouts and elevated latencies for non-premium customers in us-east. Premium routing diverted successfully. Engineers working on autoscale/provisioning and quota escalation."

mike-oncall: Draft sent to cs-ops, added incident channel link.

ops-rotation: Another mitigation: enable short-circuit caching for repeated prefix tokens for chat sessions to reduce token generation load by ~15%. Can we flip that?

jess-eng: enabling prefix cache for active sessions now. Command:
```
redwood optimize cache enable --route /v1/generate --mode prefix --ttl 30m
```
Applied at 2765432165.

mike-oncall: p95 trending down slowly. Queue length from 14k -> 6.2k over 8 minutes after routing + cache. Error rate also dropping.

sam-sre: logged root cause: cloud GPU quota exhausted in us-east + autoscaler didn't fail fast and left pending attempts that clogged control plane. Followups: make autoscaler fail-fast when pending > X, add region-fallback earlier in policy, add a quota check pre-provision.

jess-eng: i'll open follow-up ticket with infra team for autoscaler logic (INFRA-4012).

lia-product: we should prepare a customer-facing postmortem note and list affected customers. Any idea on scale of customers impacted?

sam-sre: preliminary: ~18% of requests in us-east saw >1s latency increase during peak; three high-volume customers experienced increased 5xx rates ~8-12 minutes each.

mike-oncall: handing off to day-shift oncall @sam-sre in 25 minutes. I'll add runbook steps in the thread.

jess-eng: runbook summary pasted: 
1) Route premium -> dedicated pools
2) Fallback default -> smaller quantized model
3) Enable prefix caching for active sessions
4) Clear pending provision attempts in cloud console
5) Bump autoscaler max_instances as temporary buffer
6) Open cloud quota escalation and track INC ticket
7) Post-incident: change autoscaler fail-fast thresholds, region-fallback policy, pre-provision quota check

incident-bot: Pager: oncall rotation mike-oncall acknowledged at 2765432115. Escalation to sam-sre scheduled at 2765432230.

ops-rotation: note — we should throttle bulk batch jobs to reduce long-tail resource hogs. Marking as action item.

jess-eng: all mitigations applied; monitoring closely. I'll keep thread open for the handoff to morning shift.

mike-oncall: handoff: oncall summary above + ticket INC-99877 with cloud provider. If queue growth resumes, re-route to eu-west as emergency fallback using:
```
redwood routes update --name /v1/generate --region-fallback eu-west:true
```

sam-sre: acknowledged, will pick up and continue follow-ups. I'll also run a retrospective with infra team after this calms.

lia-product: noted for customer comms. Thanks everyone. :pray:

incident-bot: Thread closed to new automated alerts at 2765432265 (manual overrides in effect).
